localHeading: A clear repair plan for Maple Heights doors
localIntro: Maple Heights is a separate southeast inner-ring city with residential garages of many ages. We start by finding out what changed: the door’s weight, its sound, its stopping point, or the way the opener responds.
localIssues: A cable that has come loose or a spring that has failed can leave a door crooked. Do not force it closed with the opener; we can inspect the lift system and explain safe repair options.
localAdvice: If the door can be repaired, we will outline the work. If replacement makes more sense, measurements and the condition of the tracks guide the next choice.
